Units: Distances in metres [m] · Angles in radians [rad] · Times in seconds [s]

Condition node.name: RandomChanceCondition
Condition node.purpose: Succeeds probabilistically based on a given chance.

inputs.name: probability
inputs.description: Chance of success (0.0-1.0).

Condition node.name: IsAgentVisible
Condition node.purpose: Determines if a target agent is visible to an observer.

inputs.name: observer_name
inputs.description: Name of the observing agent.

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Name of the target agent.

inputs.name: distance
inputs.description: Visibility distance threshold [m].

inputs.name: field_of_view
inputs.description: It defines how wide the observer’s vision is. It’s value is half of field of view angle (symmetric left and right of the forward axis) [rad].

Condition node.name: IsAgentClose
Condition node.purpose: Determines whether one agent is within a close distance of another agent.

inputs.name: observer_name
inputs.description: Name of the observing agent.

inputs.name: target_agent_name
inputs.description: Name of the target agent.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Distance threshold for close proximity [m].

Condition node.name: IsAtPosition
Condition node.purpose: Checks if the agent has reached a specified goal position within a tolerance.

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Name of the agent.

inputs.name: target_x
inputs.description: X-Coordinate of the target goal position.

inputs.name: target_y
inputs.description: Y-Coordinate of the target goal position.

Condition node.name: IsAnyoneLookingAtMe
Condition node.purpose: Determines if any agent is looking at the agent and returns the observer's identifier if the condition is met.

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the agent being observed.

inputs.name: time_step
inputs.description: Time step for movement updates [s].

inputs.name: distance_threshold
inputs.description: Maximum distance for detecting potential observers [m].

inputs.name: angle_threshold
inputs.description: Angular threshold specifying how precisely the observer must be aligned [rad].

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Duration that the condition must persist [s].

outputs.name: observer_id
outputs.description: Identifier of the agent that is looking at the target agent.

Condition node.name: IsAnyoneSpeaking
Condition node.purpose: For a specified duration, evaluates whether any agent within a given distance is speaking (publishing a ROS-2 string message).

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the agent checking for speakers.

inputs.name: time_step
inputs.description: Time step for movement updates [s].

inputs.name: distance_threshold
inputs.description: Maximum distance within which speaking is detected [m].

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Duration over which the speaking condition is evaluated.

outputs.name: speaker_id
outputs.description: Identifier of the detected speaking agent.

Condition node.name: IsLookingAtMe
Condition node.purpose: Checks whether a specified target agent is looking at the agent over a defined time, distance, and angle.

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the agent being looked at.

inputs.name: time_step
inputs.description: Time step for movement updates [s].

inputs.name: target_agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the target agent that is potentially looking.

inputs.name: distance_threshold
inputs.description: Maximum range to detect the look direction [m].

inputs.name: angle_threshold
inputs.description: Angular threshold for the looking condition [rad].

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Duration over which the condition is checked [s].

Condition node.name: IsSpeaking
Condition node.purpose: Checks whether the specified agent is actively speaking within a set distance threshold over a specified duration.

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the agent checking for the speaker.

inputs.name: time_step
inputs.description: Time step for movement updates [s].

inputs.name: target_agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the agent whose speaking status is evaluated.

inputs.name: distance_threshold
inputs.description: Distance range for detecting the speaking condition [m].

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Duration over which the condition is considered [s].

Action node.name: FindNearestAgent
Action node.purpose: Identifies the nearest agent relative to a given agent.

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the querying agent.

outputs.name: target_agent_name
outputs.description: Identifier of the nearest agent found.

Action node.name: SaySomething
Action node.purpose: Commands the agent to publish a ROS message.

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the speaking agent.

Action node.name: StopMovement
Action node.purpose: Commands the agent to immediately halt all movement (stay idle).

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the agent.

Action node.name: ResumeMovement

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the agent.

Action node.name: StopAndWaitTimerAction

inputs.name: wait_duration

inputs.name: conversation_duration

inputs.name: target_x
inputs.description: X-Coordinate of where conversation's central point will take place.

inputs.name: target_y
inputs.description: Y-Coordinate of where conversation's central point will take place.

inputs.name: time_step
inputs.description: Time step for movement updates [s].

inputs.name: non_main_agent_names
inputs.description: List of participating agent names. Must be passed as a list of string, e.g. ["hunav_1", "hunav_2"]

Action node.name: GoTo

inputs.name: target_x
inputs.description: X-Coordinate of the target goal position.

inputs.name: target_y
inputs.description: Y-Coordinate of the target goal position.

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: Distance to consider 'at goal' [m].

Action node.name: ApproachAgent
Action node.purpose: Directs the agent to move towards another agent for a defined duration.

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the approaching agent.

inputs.name: target_agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the target agent.

inputs.name: time_step
inputs.description: Time step for movement updates [s].

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Duration of the approach action [s].

Action node.name: BlockAgent
Action node.purpose: Commands the agent to block another agent's path for a defined duration.

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the blocking agent.

inputs.name: target_agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the agent to be blocked.

inputs.name: time_step
inputs.description: Time step for movement updates [s].

inputs.name: front_dist
inputs.description: Blocking distance threshold [m].

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Duration of the blocking action [s].

Action node.name: GroupWalk
Action node.purpose: Directs a group to walk together with a designated main agent.

inputs.name: main_agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the main agent guiding the group.

inputs.name: time_step
inputs.description: Time increment used for updating movement [s].

inputs.name: non_main_agent_names
inputs.description: List of the non-main agents' names. Must be passed as a list of string, e.g. ["hunav_1", "hunav_2"]

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Duration for which the behaviour runs [s]. If omitted, the behaviour runs indefinitely.

Action node.name: LookAtAgent
Action node.purpose: Directs an agent (acting as the observer) to focus on another agent.

inputs.description: Identifier of the observing agent.

inputs.name: target_agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the target agent.

inputs.name: yaw_tolerance
inputs.description: Angle tolerance to consider “aligned” [rad].

Action node.name: LookAtPoint
Action node.purpose: Makes the agent orient towards a specific point in space.

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Name of the agent.

inputs.name: target_x
inputs.description: X-Coordinate of the target point.

inputs.name: target_y
inputs.description: Y-Coordinate of the target point.

inputs.name: yaw_tolerance
inputs.description: Angle tolerance [rad] to consider “aligned”

Action node.name: FollowAgent
Action node.purpose: Commands an agent to follow another target agent.

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the follower agent.

inputs.name: time_step
inputs.description: Time step for movement updates [s].

inputs.name: target_agent_name
inputs.description: Identifier of the agent to be followed.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Duration for which the behaviour is active [s]. If omitted, the behaviour runs indefinitely.

Action node.name: FormQueue
Action node.purpose: Commands agents to queue in line, the order of agents is determined by the order of their names in the list.

inputs.name: agents_names
inputs.description: List of participating agent names. Must be passed as a list of string, e.g. ["hunav_1", "hunav_2"]

inputs.name: wait_duration
inputs.description: Durations for which each agent should wait [s].

inputs.name: front_agent_pose
inputs.description: The pose ([x, y, yaw]) of the agent in the front of the queue, the pose of agents behind will be calculated base on this agent's pose and queue direction.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: The direction of the queue line given in yaw angle, the pose of agents will be calculated base on this attribute and front agent's pose.

inputs.name: distance
inputs.description: Nominal spacing between consecutive agents in the queue.

Action node.name: AdvanceQueue
Action node.purpose: Commands multiple agents to form an ordered queue and then progress sequentially toward the front position. It first directs each agent to its designated waiting position, then successively moves to the previous agent's position as the queue advances. The order of the queue is determined by the order in which agents are listed. The progression is regulated by the built-in wait_duration, which introduces a delay every time an agent successfully occupies a new queue position, so don't use addition StopAndWaitTimer or TimeDelayDecorator nodes for this behavior.

inputs.name: agents_names
inputs.description: List of participating agent names in queue order. For example: ["hunav_1", "hunav_2", "hunav_3"]. This order determines the queue progression.

inputs.name: wait_duration
inputs.description: Base waiting time [s] applied each time an agent reaches a queue position. This pause allows the queue to progress gradually.

inputs.name: front_agent_pose
inputs.description: The pose ([x, y, yaw]) of the first agent at the front of the queue. Positions for the remaining agents are computed automatically based on this pose, direction, and distance.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Yaw angle defining the direction in which the queue extends. All waiting positions are generated along this direction.

inputs.name: distance
inputs.description: Nominal spacing between consecutive agents in the queue.

Decorator node.name: TimeDelayDecorator
Decorator node.purpose: Delays the execution of its child node by a specified amount of time. Returns FAILURE until delay elapses, then ticks child.

inputs.name: delay
inputs.description: Delay time before the child node is ticked [s].
